During the course of deliberation on 11.09.2025 regarding registration for OPD and issue of hassle free follow up by the patient(s), Prof. (Dr.) Goutam Kumar Satpathy,
Superintendent I/c., SCBMCH, Cuttack apprised this Court about the procedure followed in case of patients who were coming for follow- up check-up as per the advice given.

Accordingly, he was called upon to place on record such procedure followed, specifically highlighting the modalities to be followed by the patient in particular cases where he/she chooses to approach the same doctor, who has already examined/treated him/her.
Mr. Debasis Nayak, learned counsel for the State has produced the written instruction dated 18.11.2025 of the Medical Superintendent, SCBMCH, Cuttack, which is taken on record.

In the written instruction relating to the procedure for follow-up check-ups, specifically highlighting the modalities for patients who choose to approach the same doctor who previously examined or treated them, it is stated that while attending a patient, when the treating doctor interacts and evaluates the patient in OPD and gives conservative treatment, i.e., prescribing medicines if the patient does not require surgery intervention with certain follow up advice, specific OPD days are earmarked for each unit.
Apart from treating patients, the faculties are associated with teaching of medical students, attending OT, meetings, seminars, research activities etc.
Hence, a patient requiring consultation beyond his allotted OPD days can approach the doctor concerned in his free time inside the department concerned.
Prof. (Dr.) Goutam Kumar Satpathy, Superintendent I/c., SCBMCH, Cuttack is present through virtual mode.

He has assured this Court that relating to the issue of a patient requiring consultation with a doctor beyond his allotted OPD days, necessary instruction in this regard shall be imparted and all the HoDs of SCBMCH will be sensitized to such issue.

The said instructions shall be issued to the effect that in case, any patient wants to see the same doctor, who was the earlier treating doctor in the non-OPD days, the concerned HoDs will make an arrangement to ensure that he/she gets to meet the doctor without facing any inconvenience and necessary guidance shall be provided to the patient through the Help Desks, which are functioning in the hospital.
